text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zimbabwe press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Workers at Zimbabwe engineering company WS Craster which applied for voluntary liquidation earlier this year have taken over the company and will resume operations next January, the workers told the Herald.
It is one of a few successful bids by workers to take over financially-troubled companies in the southern African state.

- Directors of dozens of Zimbabwean pyramid scheme money clubs that have collapsed in the past week say they knew in advance the risk of their inevitable failures and had inserted disclaimer clauses in agreements with subscribing members, the officials said at the weekend.
